title: The inflammatory reflex
objective: Describe the inflammatory reflex as a neural circuit that senses and limits inflammation.

steps.title: A reflex for inflammation
steps.body: The **[[inflammatory reflex]]** is exactly what it sounds like: a [[reflex arc]] whose *afferent* limb (vagal sensory neurons) detects inflammation, and whose *efferent* [[vagus|vagal]] limb sets off a response that **dampens** it. Tracey framed immunity as being under neural reflex control.

flag.note: The efferent limb is usually drawn as vagal end to end, but the signal reaches the spleen via the splenic nerve, and the exact anatomy is still debated.

steps.prompt: What makes the inflammatory reflex a reflex *arc*?
options: It has an afferent limb that senses inflammation and an efferent limb that acts
It is only a single one-way sensory signal inward, with no corrective output at all
It involves only immune cells and does not involve any neurons
It is purely hormonal in nature, with no neural component at all
steps.explanation: Like any reflex arc (D8): sense → integrate → respond. Here the sensed variable is inflammation and the response dampens it.

variants.setup: Vagal afferents sense inflammation and vagal efferents then act to reduce it.
options: A reflex arc, with both afferent and efferent limbs
Just a one-way sensory signal travelling inward
A purely hormonal feedback loop with no nerves
variants.reveal: Sensing plus a corrective output is a reflex arc.

steps.setup: Borovikova et al. stimulated the vagus nerve in animals given an inflammatory challenge (endotoxin).
options: Vagal stimulation reduced the systemic inflammatory response
Vagal stimulation sharply worsened the ongoing inflammation
The vagus nerve had no effect on the inflammation at all
Only antibodies, and not the nerves, affected the response
steps.reveal: Stimulating the efferent vagus attenuated the systemic inflammatory response to endotoxin — the experiment that established neural reflex control of inflammation.

variants.prompt: Vagal stimulation during an endotoxin challenge…
options: Did nothing at all to the inflammation
variants.explanation: Borovikova et al. showed vagal stimulation dampens systemic inflammation.
